title: Moon's Sub-100-Meter Craters Last Under 100 Million Years: Lunar Water Ice Inside Cannot Be Ancient, Study Finds
description: Lunar water ice inside the Moon's smallest craters cannot be ancient: a new study in AGU Advances finds craters under 100 meters wide vanish within 100 million years, meaning any ice they hold arrived recently, not billions of years ago. The finding reshapes NASA's Artemis mission site selection at the lunar south pole.

title: The Cretaceous World of Egg Mountain: 150 Years of Princeton Paleontology
description: 150 Years of Princeton Paleontology brings real fossils from the University’s Geosciences collection, alongside the publications describing them, to tell the story of the scientific lineage that founded modern vertebrate paleontology.
